title: A Bit of Kindness
lines: Rosa was in the yard when the rain came.
She heard a small sound by the fence.
A pup sat there, wet and shaking with cold.
It had no tag and it was thin.
Rosa took it in and got it dry.
She fed it and it went to sleep.
Rosa was hopeful the pup had a home.
She went to each house on her street.
But no one had lost a pup at all.
So Rosa made a sign. It was helpful.
A thankful girl came the next day.
"That is my pup, Sam!" she said.
She held out a reward, but Rosa said no.
"Just come back to play," said Rosa.

questions.ask: Where did Rosa find the pup?
questions.listenFor: In the yard by the fence, wet and shaking in the cold rain. The first three lines help.

questions.ask: What did Rosa try before she made the sign?
questions.listenFor: She went to each house on her street, but no one had lost a pup.

questions.ask: Would you have taken the reward? Why?
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. Listen for a reason that fits the story.
